clue.text: Pool money before getting pricy knitwear

clue.text: Roofer performing climb gets fired again

clue.text: Dubious income when chap finally enters amateur night at the local?

clue.text: Lousy pay-cuts head of staffing's accepted, the wimp

clue.text: Drunken lecher, into brewing beer, sport and Blue Suede Shoes?

drunken suggests the letters of lecher are reeling about into a new order

explanation.definitionFit: Crepe-soled suede shoes favoured by Teddy boys in 1950s Britain, an example of the sort of shoes in the Elvis song.

clue.text: Firm friends?
